package.description: CLI Windows theme switcher for scripts, hotkeys, and scheduled tasks

en-US.description: CLI Windows theme switcher for scripts, hotkeys, and scheduled tasks
en-US.longDescription:
ThemeToggle is a lightweight command-line utility for switching Windows
between light and dark themes. It is designed for shortcuts, scripts,
hotkeys, and scheduled automation, completing a switch in a few tens of
milliseconds even on a busy desktop.

Features:
- CLI operations for /toggle, /light, and /dark
- Silent direct execution without requiring wrapper scripts
- Automation-friendly flags such as /quiet, /passthru, and /exitcode
- Compatibility refresh handling for apps that ignore standard theme broadcasts
- Multi-monitor taskbar support
- Windows 10 and Windows 11 support
- Standalone executable and portable ZIP distribution
- No runtime dependencies
en-US.name: ThemeToggle
